final: WITH funding_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'MISSING') as funding_source, COUNT(*) as group_size, AVG(sp.boxy / sp.boxz) as avg_ratio FROM scanspatial sp LEFT JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'MISSING')), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_size) as avg_size FROM funding_stats), above_avg AS (SELECT fs.funding_source, fs.group_size, fs.avg_ratio, oa.avg_size FROM funding_stats fs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE fs.group_size > oa.avg_size) SELECT AVG(aa.avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios, SUM(aa.group_size) as combined_size, AVG(aa.group_size - aa.avg_size) as avg_excess FROM above_avg aa
